usage: Rare code changes should be reviewed by a veteran dev
name: Rare code changes should be reviewed by a veteran dev
description: If a user is pushing code into a repo that they are not regular users of then the code needs to be reviewed by a veteran developer.
detailedDescription: Developers who commit very infrequently to a repo have a higher chance of introducing a security vulnerability. In order to mitigate this, it is recommended that such code changes be reviewed by a veteran developer of the repo. Reviews are one of the best ways to reduce the risk of security vulnerabilities making it to production. When researchers tried to intentionally insert malicious code into the Linux Kernel, two-man reviews caught the majority of issues.
